title: Worklet integration in Expo UI: synchronously controlling SwiftUI and Compose state
summary: Expo UI now integrates with react-native-worklets, letting you control SwiftUI and Compose state synchronously on the UI thread. No JS round-trips.
body_markdown: Expo UI now integrates with react-native-worklets, letting you control SwiftUI and Compose state synchronously on the UI thread. No JS round-trips.
